You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    def const(cells): return len(set(cells))==1
    sr=[i for i in range(H) if const([g[i][j] for j in range(W)])]
    sc=[j for j in range(W) if const([g[i][j] for i in range(H)])]
    sepv={g[i][0] for i in sr}|{g[0][j] for j in sc}
    rest=[v for v in {x for r in g for x in r} if v!=0 or True and v not in sepv]
    # background = most common value that's not a separator color
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=max((c for c in cnt if c not in sepv), key=lambda x:(cnt[x],x))
    # blocks
    rl=[]; s=-1
    for i in range(H):
        if i==sr[-1]+1: pass
    rows=[]
    last=-1
    for i in range(H):
        if i in set(sr): last=i+1
    # simpler: iterate candidate start
    rb=[]; st=0
    for i in range(H):
        if i in set(sr) or (i>st and i not in set(sr)): pass
    # redo cleanly
    def segs(ids,nat):
        res=[];s=None
        for i in nat:
            if s is None: s=i
            elif s<i: res.append((s,i)); s=i
        if s is not None and s<=i: res.append((s,None))
        return res
    rb=segs({i for i in range(H) if i not in set(sr)},H); 
    cb=[(min(r),max(r)+1) for r in rb]
    cc=segs({j for j in range(W) if j not in set(sc)},W)
    src=None; best=-1
    for ri,(a_,b_) in enumerate(cb):
        for ci,(c_,d_) in enumerate(cc):
            blk=[(i,j) for i in range(a_,b_) for j in range(c_,d_)]
            n=sum(1 for i,j in blk if g[i][j]!=bg and g[i][j] not in sepv)
            if n>best:
                best=n; src=(ri,ci,[g[i][j] for i in range(a_,b_) for j in range(c_,d_)])
    (ri,ci,tile)=src
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for k,rw in enumerate(cb):
        for kk,cw in enumerate(cc):
            h_=rw[1]-rw[0]; w_=cw[1]-cw[0]
            if (kk,ri)==(ci,ri) or False: pass
            # source occupies block index (ri,ci) -> position within source block: source tile size
            sh,sw=len(tile)//h_, len(tile)//w_ if False else None
    oh,ow=len(tile)//len(cb) if False else None
    # tile dims from source block
    sh=b_[1]-cb[ri][0]; sw=cw[1]-cc[ci][0] if False else None
